text_block_list.text: Facing a formidable rival in Buena Vista at the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Kh, *gasp*! Hah...!
Hah! Hah! Hah!
choice_data_list: Last lap! ...Come on, Pisa, you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
...I'm not done, not yet...!!

Victoire Pisa spent her days undergoing
intense training with even higher workloads.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Still too slow.
As I am now... it's not enough.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pisa-san!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Are you currently doing independent training? Would you like to run together in 15 minutes?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Why don't we do some joint training? To prepare for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...!
Hehe, yes!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*!
How... was that...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It's not bad, but there's still room for improvement.
Positioning will be crucial in the Japan Cup.
Let's be thorough.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, let's focus on a routine
to strengthen your lower body."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, countermeasures? I've only ever beaten Buena once—
and besides, I'm running in the Japan Cup myself.
I'm not about to show my hand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, but still.
If I had to pick one from all that... I guess it'd be this.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That little lady may not look it, but she's quite
full of confidence. She truly believes she's gonna win.
In other words, she never wavers.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna win, throw yourself into it like your life depends on it.
Always aim for 100% output.
No matter when, no matter what happens, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
100% of one's strength, without fail—
I see, so you mean concentration... perhaps?
And—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I've done everything that needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... today only comes once.
Will I truly be able to see it through to the end?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
... ......Hehe, I'm sorry.
I let myself sound so weak for a moment.
choice_data_list: It's okay, you can definitely do it.
It's okay, you can definitely do it!

text_block_list.text: Pulling out the tablet where I had kept records all this time, I showed her the chart of her growth.
A summer and autumn filled with rigorous training. Two mock races against higher-ranked opponents.

And after that, our days were spent
tackling even more intense training.

The fruits of the continuous effort that has been built up
are clearly reflected in the numbers.
choice_data_list: As you are now, you can stand shoulder to shoulder with Buena Vista.
As you are now, you can stand shoulder to shoulder with Buena Vista.

text_block_list.text: And surely, we can weave a circle of connection among the audience with a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
You're right.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Believing in myself, in you... and in everyone, I shall take on this challenge.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you think Buena Vista
is gonna get her 6th GⅠ victory today?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That GⅠ the other day was incredible!
That performance made it hard to believe it was their first race back from a break.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She really is on a whole 'nother level. Her popularity is insane, too.
Practically every fan out there is holding a Buena plushie!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Just as Ruler's research indicated, today's
main heroine is naturally going to be her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But it's not as though
we've been sitting on our hands either.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Let's give it everything we've got. And then—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Still, man, I really want Pisa and the others to give it their all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
The current Classic lineup is packed with talent.
Like a fresh new wind, you know...? That's what
I want to feel at the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...
I shall run a magnificent race.
One worthy of standing side-by-side with Buena Vista-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
—For both of our dreams.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Let's give it our all, together.

Carrying everyone's burning dreams,
the Japan Cup begins!
